rows.synthetic_prerequisite: Preserve six-state/two-input SI conventions, separate prediction/plant; declare validated policy/model domain.
rows.efficiency_interface: Versioned model/config identity, independent of optimizer backend.
rows.gate: New model/actuator claims need review; frozen A unchanged.

rows.synthetic_prerequisite: Actual monotonic packet times, acceptance, expiry, reserve and pending/held provenance.
rows.efficiency_interface: Nonuniform duration vectors, any horizon and variable/fixed handoff accepted only through actual timestamps; no automatic reserve credit for longer H.
rows.gate: Adapter design review before implementation; no F0 scope change.

rows.synthetic_prerequisite: Proposed uncertainty/reachability sets and timing-budget assertions; no present certified response domain.
rows.efficiency_interface: Preparation variance and release policy feed availability, not proof of safety.
rows.gate: Unknown feasibility denies hardware claims; separately authorized synthetic work may proceed under existing hard gates.

rows.synthetic_prerequisite: Epoch, lease, cancellation/ack races and endpoint validation designed/tested synthetically in future Stage B.
rows.efficiency_interface: Readiness and optimized feasible iterate remain separate from authority/application permissions.
rows.gate: Stronger pending-command policy changes enabled runtime semantics and needs explicit review, never frozen-history rewrite.

rows.synthetic_prerequisite: Failure state remains explicit; no standstill propagation using current dynamic model.
rows.efficiency_interface: No dependence on IPOPT convergence or host heartbeat alone.
rows.gate: Hardware response/timeout must be characterized before deployment.

rows.synthetic_prerequisite: Retain native physical-time causal logs and unknown/censored acknowledgements.
rows.efficiency_interface: New supervision/telemetry overhead requires deterministic parity then separately approved measured timing; no inherited cost equivalence.
rows.gate: No timing experiment or F0 profiling authorization from S0.

rows.synthetic_prerequisite: Validated domain/terminal set, hysteresis and latching requirements.
rows.efficiency_interface: Same layer serves any accepted controller; no implicit online controller switching or adaptive feature.
rows.gate: Primary must choose recovery-versus-stop objectives and admissible residual risk.
